name: Record Technical Data 4
definition: Instrument specific technical data to support identification.

InconsistencyIndicator.name: Inconsistency Indicator
InconsistencyIndicator.definition: Flag to say if there is an inconsistency across all submitting entities records.

LastUpdate.name: Last Update
LastUpdate.definition: Last date for which data was received for this instrument.

SubmissionDateTime.name: Submission Date Time
SubmissionDateTime.definition: Defines the date and time when this instrument was originally received at the submission destination.

RelevantCompetentAuthority.name: Relevant Competent Authority
RelevantCompetentAuthority.definition: Country code of the relevant competent authority of the instrument.

PublicationPeriod.name: Publication Period
PublicationPeriod.definition: Period for which the associated instrument has been publically available.

NeverPublished.name: Never Published
NeverPublished.definition: Flag to say if the record has ever been published.

RelevantTradingVenue.name: Relevant Trading Venue
RelevantTradingVenue.definition: Trading venue of the record used by the relevant competent authority to determine the reference data for the instrument.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one of the 5 elements must be present.
